findingDetails.title: The buffer regression test never asserts the premise it guards
findingDetails.scopeProof: The assertion set is the whole test body, and a search for ls-files over the file returns only this test's helper calls, so no other case measures a listing.
findingDetails.case: A maintainer trims the fixture from 6,000 files to 3,000; the listing is 558,018 bytes, under the 1,048,576-byte default cap, and the test still passes while the overflow is no longer exercised.

findingDetails.title: A listing above the cap is still reported as a spawn failure
findingDetails.scopeProof: result.error is read in two places in the builder, and git() is the only path that reports spawn_failed, so the git listing path is the whole class.
findingDetails.case: A monorepo whose git ls-files -z reaches about 512 MiB prints {"ok":false,"code":"spawn_failed"}, and the operator starts by checking whether git is installed instead of looking at the buffer.
